speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Nightmare Disorder

The history of no trauma and the description of waking up frightened points to a sleep disorder rather than an infection. Pyelonephritis is a kidney infection that would present with fever and flank pain, not isolated sleep disturbances, so I will not make that diagnosis. Do you have any nightmares regularly, and do you remember them when you wake up?
